exposure: biochemical osteomalacia reaffirmed by signs and symptoms
cohort: The study examined 71 Swedish and 52 Somali women during pregnancy and breastfeeding.
finding: Biochemical osteomalacia was associated with a significantly higher incidence of emergency instrumental delivery procedures, including vacuum-assisted delivery and emergency Caesarean sections.
mod_finding: Biochemical osteomalacia was associated with a higher incidence of emergency instrumental delivery procedures, including an increased likelihood of vacuum-assisted delivery and emergency Caesarean sections.
